1.

Thou art the Son of God, The only-begotten of Thy Father, The Man of God’s counsel of love, His soul’s chosen One, Thou art the Son of God.

2.

Thou art our peace, For peace Thou hast established With the blood of Thy cross, Jesus, our Mediator, Thou art our peace.

3.

Thou art our life, With Thee hid, We await now Thy day, Thy manifestation. Thou art our life.

4.

Thou art our hope, The long-expected One. Come and soon deliver Thy whole creation! Thou art our hope.

5.

Thou art our sun. The glow of Thy mighty love Disperses all clouds In both life and death. Thou art our sun.

6.

Thou art our joy, All heaven’s joy Thou art, And the Father’s good pleasure Ever rests upon Thee there. Thou art our joy.
